reading.body:
The "SONM" label in this registry almost certainly denotes State Of New Mexico rather than the blockchain company Supercomputing Organized by Network Mining, based on the facility's confirmed use as state government IT infrastructure.

The John F. Simms Building in Santa Fe houses New Mexico Department of Information Technology operations as part of the state Capitol's South Complex. The operator name appears to be a source-data acronym collision rather than evidence of blockchain company infrastructure. Multiple searches found no connection between the blockchain SONM project and any Santa Fe facility, while state government sources confirmed the Simms Building's role in hosting state IT operations.

This case illustrates a recurring pattern in data center registries where operator field labels can mislead without verification against independent sources. The facility itself remains documented and operational in state government use, but the operator designation requires disambiguation. No power capacity or square footage is recorded for this location.

The data covers only one facility and provides no basis for assessing New Mexico state government's total data center footprint, infrastructure spending, or computing capacity relative to AI scaling needs.
